mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_event (session_id, seq, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{eventType}, #{payload})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, seq, event_type, payload, created_at FROM agent_event WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seq ASC
SELECT id, session_id, seq, event_type, payload, created_at FROM agent_event WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY seq ASC
